apt-packages.description: Space-separated apt packages the test job installs before running the suite

coverage-ignore-regex.description: Regex of file paths to exclude from coverage (e.g. code covered only by a separate DB integration job)

coverage-threshold.description: Minimum line coverage percentage (0 disables the gate)

doc-warnings.description: Build the docs with -D warnings so broken doc links fail the build

extra-test-os.description: JSON array of extra runner images to also run tests on (e.g. '["macos-latest"]')

llvm-cov-version.description: Exact version of the tool; bumped via .github releases

msrv.description: Minimum supported Rust version to verify a --locked build against (empty disables the check)

package-check.description: Run cargo publish --dry-run on PRs to catch packaging breakage before tagging

podman.description: Start rootless Podman socket before running the coverage job (ubuntu-latest only)

run-lint.description: Run formatting and lint checks selected by the caller's plan

run-msrv.description: Check MSRV when selected by the caller's plan

run-tests.description: Run workspace tests and coverage selected by the caller's plan

semver-check.description: Run cargo-semver-checks to flag public API breaks against the last published release

semver-checks-version.description: Exact version of the tool; bumped via .github releases

toolchain.description: Rust toolchain to pin the build, lint and test jobs to

steps.name: Install toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install "$TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal --component llvm-tools
rustup default "$TOOLCHAIN"

steps.name: Install test tooling
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -n "$APT_PACKAGES" ]; then
  sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 -o Acquire::http::Timeout=30 update -qq
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # intentional word-splitting of the list
  sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=3 -o Acquire::http::Timeout=30 install -y --no-install-recommends $APT_PACKAGES
fi

steps.name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
steps.run: command -v cargo-llvm-cov >/dev/null || cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked --version "$LLVM_COV_VERSION"

steps.name: Start Podman socket
steps.run:
systemctl --user start podman.socket
until [ -S "/run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock" ]; do sleep 0.1; done
echo "path=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Coverage gate
steps.run:
cargo llvm-cov --locked --workspace --all-features --summary-only --json --output-path coverage.json \
  ${COVERAGE_IGNORE_REGEX:+--ignore-filename-regex "$COVERAGE_IGNORE_REGEX"}
PCT=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('coverage.json'))['data'][0]['totals']['lines']['percent'])")
echo "Coverage: ${PCT}% (threshold: ${COVERAGE_THRESHOLD}%)"
echo "### Coverage: ${PCT}% (threshold: ${COVERAGE_THRESHOLD}%)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
python3 - "$PCT" "$COVERAGE_THRESHOLD" <<'EOF'
import sys
pct, threshold = float(sys.argv[1]), float(sys.argv[2])
if pct < threshold:
    print(f"::error::Coverage {pct}% is below the {threshold}% threshold")
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
EOF

steps.name: Install toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install "$TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal
rustup default "$TOOLCHAIN"

steps.name: Build docs with warnings denied
steps.run: cargo doc --no-deps --all-features

steps.name: Reflect the extra-platform test result
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# `skipped` is a pass: test-extra is gated on `extra-test-os != '[]'`, so a
# caller that asks for no extra platforms has nothing to fail.
case "$RESULT" in
  success | skipped) echo "extra-platform tests: $RESULT" ;;
  *) echo "::error::extra-platform tests did not pass (result: $RESULT)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

steps.name: Install toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install "$TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
rustup default "$TOOLCHAIN"

steps.name: rustfmt
steps.run: cargo fmt --all --check

steps.name: clippy
steps.run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

steps.name: fuzz lockfile in sync
steps.run: cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml > /dev/null

steps.name: Install MSRV toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install "$MSRV" --profile minimal
rustup default "$MSRV"

steps.name: Build on the declared MSRV
steps.run: cargo build --locked --all-features

steps.name: Reflect the MSRV result
Install toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install "$TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal
rustup default "$TOOLCHAIN"

steps.name: cargo publish --dry-run
steps.run: cargo publish --dry-run --locked

steps.name: Install toolchain
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install "$TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal
rustup default "$TOOLCHAIN"

steps.name: Install cargo-semver-checks
steps.run: command -v cargo-semver-checks >/dev/null || cargo install cargo-semver-checks --locked --version "$SEMVER_CHECKS_VERSION"

steps.name: Check for public API breaks
steps.run: cargo semver-checks check-release

steps.name: Every selected job ended in success
steps.run:
set -u
failed=0
for name in LINT TEST COVERAGE SUITE MSRV DOC PACKAGE SEMVER; do
  want="WANT_$name"
  got="GOT_$name"
  case "${!want}" in
    true) [ "${!got}" = success ] || { echo "::error::$name was selected and ended in ${!got}"; failed=1; } ;;
    false) case "${!got}" in failure | cancelled) echo "::error::$name ended in ${!got}"; failed=1 ;; esac ;;
    *) echo "::error::$name: the selection is neither true nor false (${!want})"; failed=1 ;;
  esac
done
case "$GOT_EXTRA" in failure | cancelled) echo "::error::the extra-platform tests ended in $GOT_EXTRA"; failed=1 ;; esac
exit "$failed"
